working_definition: The residual fraction of Davie et al. 2018 res-2.0 cluster 27 (543 antennal-lobe olfactory projection neurons, identified by tup/otp/C15/hth expression) that GEO metadata records only as unresolved OPN - not assigned to the adPN or lPN developmental lineage, nor to any of the five Li et al. (2017) marker subgroups. Cells relay odor information from antennal-lobe glomeruli to the mushroom body calyx and lateral horn; cholinergic (ChAT/VAChT).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Adult neuron that relays olfactory (smell) information from one or more sensory neuropil regions to one or more higher brain centers.

justification: This label is explicitly the unresolved remainder of cluster 27 - cells not assigned to any finer lineage or marker group. Its identity IS 'olfactory projection neuron' at the class level; nothing in the report supports resolving it further (no lineage, no marker combination). FBbt:00051299 'adult olfactory projection neuron' captures exactly this level: an adult neuron relaying olfactory information to higher brain centers, matching the report's location (antennal lobe -> mushroom body calyx / lateral horn) and function. Adult-specific term chosen per dataset guidance (whole adult brain, 0-50 days). This is the correct/honest mapping level for a remainder label, not an artificial downgrade.

other_candidates.fbbt_term: adult antennal lobe projection neuron adPN
other_candidates.fbbt_definition: An adult antennal lobe projection neuron that is derived from neuroblast ALad1 (FBbt:00067346). All of these neurons have axons that fasciculate with the medial antennal lobe tract (mALT) and innervate the lateral horn.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Would require assigning this label to the adPN lineage, which the report explicitly states is NOT resolved for this residual fraction.

other_candidates.fbbt_term: adult antennal lobe projection neuron lPN
other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Adult antennal lobe projection neuron that belongs to the dorsal (Notch OFF) hemilineage of the lateral antennal lobe neuroblast (ALl1) (Lin et al., 2012; Bates et al., 2020). Its cell body is located in the lateral part of the cell body rind of the antennal lobe.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Would require assigning this label to the lPN lineage, which is likewise unresolved for this residual fraction.

recommendation: Accept as exact match at the class level; this is a genuine remainder/unresolved group, not a forced generalisation.
